articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection using modified VGG-19 and Inception ResnetV2 models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: A brain tumor is characterized as an aggregation of abnormal cells within the brain. These tumors can be classified into two categories: malignant and benign. Malignant is cancerous whereas benign is not. Both tumors are very hazardous as they grow rapidly and attack different parts of the cerebrum. Even after extensive research, the cause of the brain tumor is unknown. In this paper, a VGG-19 and an Inception-Resnet V2 model are presented for detecting brain tumor by employing images of MRI scans. The dataset is gathered from Kaggle and preprocessed using Keras Image Data Generator. The VGG-19 model provided an accuracy of 99.71% and the Inception-Resnet V2 provided an accuracy of 99.28%. The proposed models performed well to achieve the task.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Implementation of a Smart Irrigation Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In the Indian agricultural scenario, efficient water management is crucial due to limited water resources and the dependence of agriculture on irrigation. In this paper, the main objective is to address the issue of wasteful water utilization and a lack of automation in conventional irrigation techniques, for which, a Smart Irrigation Management System (SIMS) is being implemented. The system attempts to optimize the quantity of water used for irrigation based on the moisture content in the soil, ambient temperature, and humidity and reduce water waste while enhancing plant development through the use of field-deployed sensors, data analysis, and automation. The system combines the capabilities of the microcontroller with a mobile application to provide this comprehensive solution. It also provides control options, enabling users to manually initiate irrigation processes or automatically control the process as needed based on the sensor data. One novel feature highlighted in this work is the monitoring of water levels in the tank using float switches, which further enhances the automation of the irrigation process based on the availability of water in the tank.

articleTitle: Detecting Mango Leaf Disease with VGG 16 Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Mango leaf disease is a major issue affecting worldwide mango trees. If left untreated, it can cause substantial damage to the leaves and potentially cause the tree to die. The importance of early discovery in controlling the spread of this disease and minimizing its impact on the mango tree population cannot be overstated. The dataset contains 4000 photos separated into eight distinct classifications. Each class reflects a different type of mango leaf disease. The dataset has two types of data: training data and validation data. There are 3200 photos in the training data and 800 images in the validation data. This article investigated the significance of early detection of mango leaf disease and the possible application of the VGG 16 Transfer Learning Model to solve this issue. Our study in illness detection has achieved encouraging results through systematically collecting and preprocessing data, training a model with carefully selected hyperparameters, and evaluating the model's performance. Our work is very accurate, with a 97% accuracy rate. Using the VGG 16 Transfer Learning Model for mango leaf disease identification can drastically reduce the time and effort necessary for human inspection methods. This is especially crucial for large-scale agricultural companies. Aside from its multiple advantages, this technology has the potential for better precision and accuracy in assessing crop problems, allowing for enhanced farming practices and increased crop output.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of a Grid-Connected Solar PV System in North-Eastern India, Manipur
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In this work, studied the performance assessment of a 5kW grid-connected solar photovoltaic (PV) system which is installed at Imphal, Manipur, India. The experimental data was recorded from 1$^{st}$ May 2022 to 30$^{th}$ April 2023 based on real time observation. This research aims to encourage the use of solar PV systems in government and residential buildings in Manipur, India, based on the findings. In the research, performance evaluations of several aspects, including as energy output, final yield, system efficiency, performance ratio (PR), and others, are included. The proposed system provided an average monthly energy supply of 451.39 kWh to the grid during this period. It is found that the performance ratio is 63.17 % which is quite comparable with other system installed at different locations. Additionally, it is obtained that the capture loss (CL), system loss (SL), system efficiency (Sys$_{eff}$) and capacity factor (CF) are 1.5 kWh$/ \mathrm{m}^{2} /$day, 0.15 kWh$/ \mathrm{m}^{2} /$day, 11.08 % and 12.30 % respectively. To study the practicability of the solar PV technology at the site, we compared the observed performance to simulation results generated by the PVsyst software. It is obtained that the suggested system's achieved performance results are in good agreement with other systems situated in various locations.

articleTitle: Design and compare the HA and FA circuits using Gate Diffusion Input (GDI) technique based on 18 nm FinFET technology for improved power efficiency and performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The most significant challenge in designing adders using the gate diffusion input (GDI) technology is minimizing the anticipated area, power consumption, and propagation delay. In this article, we have compared both the Half Adder (HA) and Full Adder (FA) circuits using the GDI technique. After simulation, it was determined that the HA circuit performed better in terms of power, delay, power delay product (PDP), and energy-delay product (EDP), while the FA circuit consumed a larger area for its design. The PDP of the HA circuit at 1 V is $2.237\times 10^{-16}{\mathrm{J}}$, at 0.9 V it is $1. 549\times 10^{-16}J$, and at 0.8 V it is $1. 259\times 10^{-16} {\mathrm{J}}$, respectively. The EDP at 1 V is $50.057\times 10^{-22}$, at 0.9 V it is $23.995 \times 10^{-22}$, and at 0.8 V it is $15.850\times 10^{-22}$, respectively. These HA and FA circuits may find applications in both biological and medical healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of a Back Surface Cooling Type PV Panel Based on Energy and Exergy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: A photovoltaic (PV) cell is extremely sensitive to shifts in temperature; conversely, a drop in temperature is the primary factor that contributes to an increase in the electrical efficiency and output power of a PV system. To maximize the amount of energy produced by PV panels and decrease their temperature, a photovoltaic (PV) cooling system is frequently employed. However, more irradiance is frequently associated with higher temperatures, which is problematic for photovoltaic (PV) panels because they rely on that irradiance to create power. These extreme temperature rises have a devastating effect on how efficiently photovoltaic (PV) panels convert energy. A solar photovoltaic (PV) system can function more efficiently with an adequate cooling process on its surface. In this paper a passive cooling model for the PV panel has been proposed which cools down the PV panel by using dry grass and water at the back surface. A comparison has been made with a non-cooled panel. Two PV panels are simultaneously tested. Electrical output characteristics of both the PV panels have been recorded and, energy and exergy analysis for the system has been presented to have a more elaborate understanding of the cooling effect on PV panel performance. The cooled panel has an increase in efficiency by 47%. Along with the electrical efficiency, the thermal efficiency has also been considered in this paper for performance evaluation in the form of overall efficiency.

articleTitle: A Strong PUF-based Authentication for Medical IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Due to nodes in the Internet of Medical Things are generally implemented in accessible, unsecured contexts, authentication of devices is crucial. In order to address hardware security issues in Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) networks, Physically Unclonable Function (PUF), a semiconductor fingerprinting, may be useful. This fingerprint may be used to produce keys for cryptography since it is based on the natural physical variations that occur during device manufacture. These variations are obtained by Challenge-Response Pairs and are created at random. However, the device’s reactions are affected by changes in outside factors such as moisture, temperature, aging, and fluctuations in voltage. The proposed design has its performance enhanced with 99.73 % reliability, 56.42 % uniformity, and 48.73 % uniqueness using an efficient error correction mechanism.

articleTitle: No Idle Constraint In Flow Shop Scheduling With Transportation Time, Weightage of Jobs And Job Block Criteria
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In the present paper, a flow shop scheduling model in two stage under no idle constraint has been studied where the transportation time is taken for transferring a job from one machine to another and the two of the jobs has been grouped as a block. Due to their practicality and significance importance in the actual life scenarios, the weight of jobs is also introduced. The study’s goal is to introduce a heuristic algorithm that, when implemented, offers an optimal or nearly optimal schedule to diminish the idle time and lowering the rental costs. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through a numerical sample.

articleTitle: Strawberry Leaf Disease Detection using Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Strawberries are one of the world’s most popular and prized fruits, prized for their delicious flavor and vibrant color. Strawberry crops, like other plant species, are susceptible to a variety of diseases that can have a significant impact on their growth, yield, and overall quality. Plant disease detection in a timely and precise manner is critical for maintaining plant health and sustaining agriculture. Traditional methods, which involve expert manual inspection, are inefficient. To address this issue, the study looks into the use of Transfer Learning Models with pre-trained neural networks to detect strawberry leaf diseases. The research aims to reliably identify and classify diseases by fine-tuning models such as MobilNetV2, EfficientNetB0, and ResNet18. The models’ accuracy is 80%, 99%, and 64%, respectively, with the EfficientNetB0 achieving a fantastic 99% accuracy. This methodology, which utilizes the power of deep learning and transfer learning techniques, has the potential to revolutionize agriculture by providing an effective and scalable method for disease identification, resulting in better crops and more sustainable practices.

articleTitle: Microgrid control based on Sliding Mode Control using Higher Order Super-Twisting Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The inherent drawbacks of conventional droop control technique in islanded microgrids, result in deviation of voltage amplitude and frequency. Maintaining voltage and frequency to standard value is necessary for the islanded microgrid. This paper presents a robust controlling method called Sliding Mode Control (SMC) using Higher Order Super Twisting Algorithm (HOSTA). To improve the performance of droop control, the proposed controller is employed to control inner loop voltage and current control. Super Twisting Algorithm (STA) output ensures that the errors are converging in a finite time. The proposed system uses two DG units, which are commonly sharing common loads. To verify the performance of the proposed controller, it is simulated using Matlab/Simulink, and results are presented.

articleTitle: Improved Gravitational Search Algorithm based Hysteresis controller for Grid integrated SPV system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Newton’s law of gravity has served as a source of inspiration for numerous optimization techniques across various research fields, both directly and indirectly. Among these techniques is the Improved Gravitational Search Algorithm (IGSA), approach has been successfully employed to address optimization challenges within the realm of engineering disciplines. IGSA draws motivation from gravity-related theories and has been adapted into different variants, including real, discrete, binary, single-objective, and multi-objective GSA, to address various engineering challenges. In this research article, the designing of PI controller of MPPT and IGSA along with the Hysteresis controller to address the SPV grid-connected issues, particularly during partial shading conditions. MATLAB Simulink-based model has been used to validate the proposed model.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accuracy of Sleep Disorder with Logistic Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Now-a-days, sleeping disorder are a topic of concern among the youth and person with different health problems. It is important to note that sleep problems are not a recent occurrence and are not something to be sought after or embraced as a trend, even if it is true that sleep-related concerns have gained greater attention and discussion in recent years as a result of increasing knowledge and study. This disorder can create various problems like anxiety, depression and burden on person’s mental health. In few past year’s artificial intelligence and machine learning has become a powerful and useful tool in market. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can perform the task related to decision making, prediction, classification and many more. The algorithm will become increasingly accurate and effective as computers get more powerful and their technical features are improved. Dataset from the Kaggle in being taken on sleep disorder and test on various python models. Considering various aspects like age, gender, occupation, blood pressure, physical activities and many more. The proposed model is assessed and compared with some existing models, such as support vector machines, decision trees, k-nearest neighbors, and logistic regression, which are demonstrated to be more accurate and effective. After comparing and testing many models using various criteria, logistic regression revealed that the suggested model had the greatest accuracy 93.51%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based identification of topology and event classification in distribution system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy sources for decentralized power generation in the existing power system network has resulted in continuous changing topology of the network. The existing adaptive protection schemes to protect such a dynamic network have certain limitations which need to be addressed in time to make the power system protection more reliant and accurate. Supervised machine learning can be used to train the relay to estimate the topology, classify the fault, estimate the status of the circuit breaker and isolate the faulty section from the healthy section. All these functions can be performed even in the case of limited communication infrastructure. Scientists and utility engineers are looking for adopting machine learning techniques to protect a distribution system network in case of communication failure. This paper deals with the application of machine learning algorithms to identify distinct topologies resulting from the connection and disconnection of renewable energy sources. The second objective is to train the algorithm to find the status of the network. A comparison between SVM and CNN is carried out and their efficiencies are compared. The effectiveness of this approach is tested on a modified IEEE 15 bus system using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Lightweight Stream Cipher for Health Care IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Recently, the exponential expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices and an increasing need for secure communication have presented novel challenges for cryptographic algorithms. Lightweight cryptography has emerged as a promising solution for dealing with the constraints of resource-constrained devices while maintaining security. Presently, a variety of lightweight cryptographic algorithms offer several advantages during implementation. Nevertheless, the extensive range of choices can challenge determining the appropriate IoT device, context, and timing for ensuring security. This paper present a comprehensive study on the design and applications of stream cipher based on nonlinear feedback shift registers (NLFSRs) in lightweight cryptography. NLFSRs are simple shift register-based structures with low computational overhead and minimal hardware requirements. The performance analysis of the proposed method for random and pseudorandom number generators includes a statistical test called the NIST test. The evaluation of the outcomes demonstrates that the scheme is both highly secure and lightweight.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic and Thermal Modelling of a Dry-Type Transformer using FEMM and ANSYS Maxwell
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This study investigates the electromagnetic and thermal behavior of a 250V/12V, 250VA dry-type transformer using Finite Element Method (FEM). For this investigation, electromagnetic modelling is performed using both FEMM and ANSYS Maxwell, and thermal modelling is performed using ANSYS Maxwell software. The study design of this investigation involves the creation of a 2D transformer model followed by electromagnetic and thermal simulations. The required parameters for the modelling are taken from the physical measurement and ratings of the transformer. Hence, the temperature distribution of the transformer is investigated from the thermal modelling at ambient temperature conditions (i.e. $30^{\circ}\mathrm{C})$ and is verified with the real-time thermal distribution of the transformer using an infrared thermal camera (Model No.: FLIR E6XT). The thermal modelling reveals that the transformer's hot spot is located near the winding, and the temperature rise is within the acceptable limit that can assure the suitability of the transformer design. In addition to that, the magnetic flux distribution in the transformer is investigated through electromagnetic modelling. From the analysis of electromagnetic modelling, the core loss is estimated. The estimated core loss value using both software provides a good correlation which ensures the effectiveness of the proposed modelling technique. In this context, the present investigation demonstrates that the FEM simulations can be a useful tool to calculate the magnetic flux distribution, core loss and thermal behavior of the transformer. The results obtained from this study can aid in the design and optimization of dry-type transformers.

articleTitle: Prediction of Reliability Factor For Multi-State Computer System With Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The present study’s main objective is to analyze the availability of the computer network system. This system consists of three interconnected subsystems: a load balancer, distributed database servers, and centralized distributed database servers. The mathematical model is developed based on a neural network approach, and the system performance is estimated with a transition diagram. Neural weights are calculated with the help of exponential distributed failure and repair rate. The system profit is optimized with the help of the neural network approach.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman Filter Approach for State of Charge Estimation of Lithium-Ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing concern over the escalating severity of global environmental degradation and the energy problem. The lithium-ion battery is extensively used in automotive applications owing to its extended lifespan and superior energy density. The measurement of the state of charge (SOC) of a Li-ion battery has significant importance as an indication. Ensuring the safe functioning of Li-ion batteries relies on the precise calculation of State of Charge (SOC). Nevertheless, the conventional technique of estimation, known as the ampere-hour integration approach, is susceptible to cumulative error and lacks the ability to sustain accurate outcomes over prolonged periods within an operational setting. Subsequently, the extended Kalman filter (EKF) approach is used to address the estimate inaccuracy. The test system has been constructed in MATALAB/Simulink in order to examine the effectiveness of the suggested technique. The simulation results demonstrate that the suggested technique outperforms previous methods in terms of performance and estimate SOC accurately across various working situations.

articleTitle: Demand Response Strategy from Delay and Non-linearity Constrained Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This article presents a demand response strategy for managing electric vehicle (EV) charging rates in a community, addressing grid overloading during peak demand. The strategy dynamically adjusts charging and discharging rates based on real-time grid conditions, optimizing energy utilization and battery life. Additionally, an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is implemented for accurate State of Charge (SoC) estimation, considering measurement noise and time delays in SoC measurements. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategies, ensuring efficient EV integration and maintaining grid stability. The findings provide valuable insights for policymakers, utilities, and researchers seeking sustainable EV integration within smart grids for a greener energy future.

articleTitle: Optimizing Pesticide Spraying Efficiency through Disease Leaf Detection Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative solution for enhancing the effectiveness of pesticide spraying by utilizing a mechanism that detects disease in leaves. The system utilizes sensors and imaging technology to detect diseased leaves in plants. Once identified, the system activates an optimized pesticide spraying mechanism that specifically targets the affected areas. The objective of the system is to improve crop productivity by administering accurate quantities of pesticides to plants, which is determined by the detection of diseased leaves in real-time. The system is designed with simplicity and user-friendliness in mind, enabling farmers to seamlessly incorporate it into their current farming operations. The system is designed to decrease the amount of pesticides used in farming while also minimizing the negative impact on the environment. This contributes to the implementation of sustainable farming practices.

articleTitle: Secure quantum communication using trusted third party
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: A quantum internet is one of the promises of the second quantum revolution. New difficulties arise when the first quantum network (QN) hardware prototypes get closer to completion. The development of scalable QN systems is still in its early stages, yet a functioning network is more than simply the physical tools. The proposed method offers a QN protocol that addresses the novel conceptual and technological difficulties posed by quantum physics and enables end-to-end quantum communication. As the key procedure in quantum information science, quantum entanglement swapping (QES) has the potential to revolutionise QN communication. The suggested paradigm, which considers entanglement, enables safe communication utilising a trusted third party across a long-distance QN. The protocols might act as the basic structure of a future quantum internet. Even if scaling and entanglement coherence issues must be overcome, this research provides the groundwork for improving error-correcting codes and fault-tolerant quantum computers.

articleTitle: Comparative study on Analog & RF Performance of an Underlapped DG InAlGaN/GaN based MOS-HEMT between GaN layer width and InAlGaN layer width variation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In this paper, the behaviour of a Double-Gate symmetric Underlapped heterojunction-based InAlGaN/GaN MOS-HEMT device, using Hafnium Oxide to serve as the high-k dielectric Gate material, on the basis of analog and RF factors have been analysed from a comparison viewpoint between separate GaN and InAlGaN layer thickness variation. Studies were conducted by diversifying GaN layer and InAlGaN layer thickness individually for multiple ratios while holding the other constant. Drain current ($\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}}$), output resistance (r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>), transconductance ($\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$), transconductance generation factor ($\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$/$\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}}$) along with different RF figure of merits (FOMs), have all been taken into consideration when evaluating the device performance. Studies show that varying InAlGaN width to increase the GaN width to InAlGaN width ratio is a more efficient method as analog parameters like $\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$ and $\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$/$\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}}$ give 29.3% and 18.5% improvement for InAlGaN variation and also this method show ameliorated differences in RF performance.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of High Efficient based Soft Switching Step Down DC-DC Converter for Battery Charging in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This topology deals with ZVS soft switching based synchronous step-down DC-DC converter during switching transitions. The implementation of an active unidirectional auxiliary circuit allows for the achievement of soft switching conditions in the synchronous leg switches. As a result, this effectively reduces the stress or burden on the switches, thus ameliorating overall converter efficiency. This proposed topology can be used for battery charging in EV applications. The paper provides an intricate analysis and explanation of the operational aspects of the proposed topology. Additionally, the results are assessed via Simulink/MATLAB platform and verified experimentally.

articleTitle: Analysis of Islanded Micro-Grid for Radial and Meshed Distribution Networks using Zbus Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Power flow solution of radial and meshed distribution system using Zbus Matrix is presented here, which is different from the topology based or the network identification based methods. Here the Zbus Matrix (New) is directly build using Type-1 and Type-2 modifications of the existing Zbus matrix (Old). The computation time of power flow solution with this method is less than the previous methods. Also the proposed algorithm easily extended to the power flow solution for a meshed distribution system. The calculation of droop constant Zn for single feeder multi-DG Micro-Grid system is possible with the proposed approach. The proposed algorithm robustness has been tested on a standard IEEE-33 Bus Radial and Meshed distribution system and the results obtained were validated with the previous methods.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy Storage Systems for Efficient Energy Management in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Microgrids have become a promising decentralized and effective energy distribution alternative in modern power systems. Energy storage systems (ESS) management is a crucial component of microgrid operation to maintain efficient energy utilization and grid stability. The Energy management system is vital in achieving sustainability and cost-efficiency in microgrid systems. This work deals with the challenges of optimizing energy storage systems to manage energy efficiently within microgrids. The paper suggests a method based on an optimization approach to achieve the best possible performance from energy storage systems to minimize the power drawn from the grid. The proposed system optimally manages solar panels, grid power, and battery storage to meet variable load demands by integrating data-driven and physics-based models with MATLAB and Simulink. Two optimization techniques are compared to analyze their impact on cost and grid utilization. The results determine the effectiveness of the optimization approaches in achieving energy and cost savings.

articleTitle: Classification and Clustering of Internet of Things (IoT) for Integrating IoT Services Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Information technology nowadays focuses on service environments provided by the “Internet of Things or IoT” due to this rapid growth of advanced technologies such as wireless connectivity, sensors, and cloud computing. In other words, building management, smart homes, surveillance services, as well as smart farms are all examples of where IoT technology is now widely deployed. IoT is the next step in computing, connectivity, and communication, with actual items all around the earth connecting to the network and exchange information. This is an information-driven strategy. As a result, it can be considered as a rapidly developing physical network of developing physical things. Using different protocols, the devices reliably and safely transmit information obtained from their environs through the medium of communication. To solve difficulties of compatibility and interoperability, the protocols implicated are being standardised. In the system, each linked object is uniquely identified and managed. The aim of this paper is to develop classification as well as clustering system of IoT service. Primary quantitative or “survey and secondary qualitative methods” are used in this research to collect statistical and theory-based information.

articleTitle: Study of a Proposed Precoding Scheme for Multi-User MIMO-PD-NOMA Paradigm with Experimental Validation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The union of Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) with Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) scheme improves the effectiveness of the latter thereby boosting its spectral efficiency and robustness, while reducing latency. These features make MIMO-NOMA a more favourable option for beyond 5G networks, serving both broadband and machine-to-machine communication systems. Precoding is one of the major aspects of MIMO technology and a pivotal technique in wireless communication system that aims to uplift the overall system performance. Therefore, this paper proposes a new precoding technique, which is a modified version of Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) precoding, and hence, compares its performance with some of the prominent existing precoding schemes, in regard to power-domain NOMA (PD-NOMA), applying Constrained optimization Power Allocation (COPA) strategy, for a downlink network scenario. The performance of diverse precoding techniques, on a two-user MIMO-PD-NOMA (MIMO-NOMA) paradigm, are inspected on grounds of various modulation schemes, System Bit Error Rate (BER) and Sum Capacity, both on a simulation platform as well as on a Software Defined Radio (SDR) kit for experimental validation.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Single Phase Induction Motor using TRIAC and Bluetooth Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Inspite of various data inspiration from various speed monitor and control techniques many industrial applications require the ability to adjust and maintain a constant speed for high-quality production. With advancements in automation and process control, the requirement for adjustable speed drives has rapidly progressed. In the past, DC motors were commonly used for variable speed drive applications, but in recent years, induction motors have become the preferred choice for various applications such as industrial drives and automotive control. As a result, there has been a growing demand for adjustable speed drives in the industry. Thus, speed control of an induction motor is necessary for multiple reasons, including energy efficiency, precision control, and relieving the motor of irrelevant stress. This paper focuses on regulating the speed of a single-phase induction motor with an Android application. Using an Android mobile with Bluetooth wireless communication and the TRIAC firing angle (via a potentiometer knob) control method, a system has been developed for controlling the speed of an AC motor. Here, the speed can be adjusted from 0% to 100% in three distinct intervals. The proposed technique is also cloud supported so that an individual can monitor the data.

articleTitle: MFOFSE Filter Based Grid Controller For Three Phase Grid Connected Solar PV Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The demonstrated System utilized a boost converter to achieve the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) operation of solar PV system by utilizing a perturb and observe (P&O) based MPPT technique. The proposed system has used the “Multilayered fourth-order fundamental signal extractor (MFOFSE)”, a new fundamental signal extractor topology, in the grid controller for harmonics mitigation operation and synchronization operation. The primary objective of the demonstrated system is to obtain a quick, safe, and unfailing control technique for mitigation of grid current harmonics on the utility grid side and supplying an uninterrupted power supply to a non-linear load at any grid anomalies condition in the availability of the grid. The proposed system was examined on the MATLAB Simulink platform for several grid anomalies, and its conduct was found well within the IEEE 519 norms.

Author Keywords: and MFOFSE (Multilayered Fourth-Order Fundamental Signal Extractor)

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Transmission Line Faults using LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: As the concepts of smart grid increases, modern power system needs to transform into smart power system that integrate advance automatic monitoring and control approaches. Transmission lines that run over a long distance in rough geographical terrain have more chances to faults since they are exposed to natural environment. Faults, if not diagnose adequately leads to system’s equipment damage, power quality problem and even power outages in the worst case. Therefore, for a stable and reliable operation of power system, faults must be detected and classified as early as possible to protect the transmission line and save the system from severe damage. In this paper, long short-term memory (LSTM), a deep learning-based approach is implemented to detect and classify different types of symmetrical and unsymmetrical transmission line faults. A single end fed short transmission line is developed using MATLAB/Simulink to generate fault dataset to train LSTM models. The network is trained and tested with 70% and 30% of the generated fault dataset. The results show, LSTM can detect faults with an accuracy of 99.58% and classify faults with an accuracy of 94.17 %.

articleTitle: Scenario of Solar Power based Electric Vehicle Charging Station in India
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) adoption in India has expanded significantly in recent years, owing to government initiatives, improved consumer awareness, and advancements in technology. This study presents an in-depth overview of India’s current EV surroundings, including industry developments, customer behavior, and regulatory laws. The study utilizes both primary and secondary data sources to examine the challenges faced by the Indian EV industry and assesses the potential for future growth. Finding suggest that while progress has been made, the infrastructure and supply chain issues still need to be addressed to ensure the widespread adoption of Electric vehicles (EVs) in India. The analysis concludes with recommendations for stakeholders to overcome these obstacles and create a more favorable climate for the expansion of India’s EV sector.

articleTitle: An Efficient Blockchain-based Auditing Scheme for EHR in Intelligent Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) are health records that are digitally stored and consist of data about a person’s wellness and increasing gradually. To store the EHR, a cloud service provider provides the storage for storing the EHR. By storing the data on the cloud, the integrity of data is a big concern for the EHR owner. Many Blockchain-based data integrity schemes are proposed for data integrity verification in which binary Merkle tree and quad Merkle tree are used, which increases the verification time for the EHR. To reduce the verification time in integrity auditing, the proposed scheme uses the ternary Merkle tree-based Blockchain for integrity auditing. The experiment and results show that verification time is reduced to 3 times lesser than the quad Merkle tree-based Blockchain and also reduces the execution time to 3.5 times lesser than the previous scheme. The security analysis shows that the proposed scheme is secured against some of the potential threats.

articleTitle: Decentralised Power Sharing Using Non Ideal Boost Converter with Internal Fuzzy logic control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This paper presents a study on power sharing in microgrids using non-ideal unidirectional boost converters. The proposed system employs non-fossil fuel energy source such as wind, solar, and battery energy reservoir, each connected to a separate unidirectional boost converter. Fuzzy logic control is utilized as the primary controller for these DC-DC (boost) converters to address their nonlinearity. The unidirectional boost converters are interconnected through a shared DC link, enabling the implementation of droop control to facilitate load sharing. The droop coefficient is adaptable through decentralized control to achieve the desired power sharing. The simulation and hardware results are utilized to showcase the efficacy of the proposed system in effectively distributing power among multiple distributed energy resources.

articleTitle: Parametric Analysis on PEM Fuel Cell for Mobility Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEMFC) is used in the mobility sector due to low operating temperature and higher efficiency. The objective of the research work is the parametric study on PEM fuel cell employed with single, double and triple serpentine flow channels. The experiments are carried out on fuel cell test facility and studied the influence of operating temperature, back pressure, and relative humidity. The solid electrolyte used for the study is the Nafion-112 membrane. A membrane electrode assembly (MEA) with 50% porosity is used for the tests. Characteristic curves of the fuel cell provided in this study are useful to understand the influence of each parameter. The findings demonstrate that, the fuel cell with the triple serpentine flow channel exhibits superior electrochemical performance in comparison to the fuel cell with double and single flow channels. The current density of Nafion-112 membrane at 0.4 volts and 100% relative humidity is 35.2% greater than Nafion-117 membrane at 95% relative humidity.

articleTitle: Influence of Introducing Symmetric Underlap on Analog Performance of Dual Gate AlGaN/GaN MOS-HEMT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Effect of introducing a symmetric source/drain underlap layer in heterojunction Dual Gate (DG) Metal Oxide High Electron Mobility Transistors (DG MOS-HEMTs) with AlGaN/GaN interface on analog Figure of Merits (FOM) is considered in the present investigation. The analog specifications considered are transconductance generation factor (TGF), transconductance (g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>) and drain current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf>) w.r.t gate voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</inf>). A 94.8% increase in ON current is observed for the device without underlap layer when compared with a device with symmetric source/drain underlap. A better transconductance peak is observed for the device without underlap with peak of 44.8% higher when juxtaposed with the symmetric underlap device, but the symmetric underlap device shows a 8.6 times higher TGF and a lower effect to Short Channel Effects like Drain Induced Barrier Lowering (DIBL) and Sub-Threshold Swing (SS).

articleTitle: A Single-Source 13-level Switched-Capacitor Multilevel Inverter with a Lower Switch Count
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This paper presents a 13-level switched capacitor multilevel inverter based on a single source. The design does not require an H-bridge to generate polarity, resulting in a reduction in maximum switch voltage. The structure can generate 6 times more voltage than the input voltage using the switched-capacitor technique. Furthermore, the structure provides more capacitor charging possibilities than others which reduces the capacitor size as compared to others. The working principle, the analysis of voltage stress, and the capacitor selection procedure are all thoroughly discussed. An extensive comparison study demonstrates that, in comparison to similar inverters, the suggested structure requires fewer components and offers a higher boosting ability. An extensive simulation study considering various loads has been conducted to validate the performances of the proposed inverter.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Lithium-Ion Battery Considering Round Trip Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Recent times have witnessed significant progress in battery technology due to the growing demand for energy storage systems in various applications. Consequently, battery efficiency has become a crucial aspect of modern battery technology since it directly influences battery performance and lifespan. To guarantee the optimal performance and longevity of batteries, it is essential to measure and understand the battery’s round-trip efficiency, which refers to the ratio of energy delivered from the battery during discharge to the energy stored in the battery at the time charging process. The objective of the current study is to investigate and analyse the lithium-ion battery round-trip efficiency. A mathematical model has been established to calculate the battery’s coulombic efficiency over a charge-discharge cycle. A comprehensive analysis has been carried out on the developed model to evaluate and compare different battery aspects. By elaborating a correlation between battery efficiency - ambient temperature, battery age, discharge capacity, capacity retention, and round-trip time, this study provides valuable insights into battery performance and optimization. This information will help in understanding battery behaviour and the impact of efficiency on battery technology development. Ignoring battery efficiency can result in lower performance and reduced battery lifespan, hampering battery technology progress. This study aims to contribute to the field’s advancement by providing valuable data on battery efficiency.

articleTitle: Analytical Comparison of Analog/RF Performance of DG InAlGaN/GaN based MOS-HEMTsfor GaN width variation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This article investigates the effect of varying buffer layer width of underlapped double gate InAlGaN/GaN MOS-HEMT’s with Hafnium based high-k dielectric gate oxide material on its Analog/RF performance. Analog performance parameter considered in the present investigation are output current $(\mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{d}}-\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{ds}})$; transconductance $(\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}})$; transconductance generation factor (TGF); Output resistance $(\mathrm{r}_{0})$ and Intrinsic Gain $(\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}\mathrm{r}_{0})$. From the small signal model, variation in Gate to Drain Capacitance $(C_{gd})$ and Gate to Source Capacitance $(\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{gs}})$ with frequency of operation has been considered. Further variation in Cut Off Frequency $(f_{\mathrm{T}})$ and maximum Frequency of Oscillation (f $\mathrm{fAx}_{\mathrm{MA}}$) with respect to Gate Voltage $(\mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{gs}})$ has also been considered. A comprehensiveevaluation of the Analog and RF Performances indicate that the electrical properties of the devices are largelyinfluenced by the GaN width. The device with greaterGaN width exhibits lower threshold voltage along with 11. 19% higher ON current and better gate controllability. Devices having narrowerGaN width perform optimally for a 5.37% wider range of radio frequency.

articleTitle: Effects of Standard and Non-standard Lightning Impulse on Dry-type Nomex Insulation Samples
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In this article, the effect of five different non-standard lightning impulses and one standard impulse have been investigated on seven different types of Nomex dry-type insulation. For this investigation, seven test samples are prepared in the laboratory with Nomex paper insulation along with nano-composites-based varnish. Therefore, the polarization and depolarization currents (PDC) of the test samples are measured at 1 kV/mm D.C. field stress. Based on the measured PDC data of the test samples, their equivalent insulation model (i.e. Debye Model parameters) are estimated. Therefore, in the simulation platform, the standard and five different non-standard impulse voltages have been applied across the insulation equivalent model. In this context, the generated response currents are recorded for each sample. Finally, the recorded currents are compared with each other. From this investigation, it is observed that the current magnitude is reduced for the nano-particle-based composite insulation compared to the pure Nomex-based dry-type insulation.

articleTitle: Reliability Improvement Technique Considering Various Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Integrating renewable energy into power systems has positive and challenging impacts on reliability. Challenges include intermittency and variability, grid integration, planning, and forecasting associated with renewable energy and power system reliability. Various strategies are employed to address these challenges and ensure power system reliability. The proposed work suggests a reliability improvement technique considering wind and solar renewable energy sources (RES). The technique has been implemented on the two benchmark systems (BS), the IEEE 33-bus distribution system and the IEEE 24-bus reliability test systems (RTS). Firstly, the losses and voltage profile have been obtained considering no RES (Scenario 1). Secondly, both test systems are tested with one RES (Scenario 2). Third, the systems are tested with two RESs (Scenario 3). Finally, the reliability in different scenarios is calculated for the unity power factor, and it is concluded that the reliability has improved considerably in the third scenario compared to the first.

articleTitle: Implementation of Low-Pass Filter Using Only MOS Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This research article comes with a design of first order and second order voltage-mode (VM) low-pass filter (LPF) using MOSFET only. A traditional RC based low pass filter uses passive resistor and capacitor but the proposed design utilizes MOSFET based resistor and capacitor for the implementation of filter. The proposed filter cut off frequency (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</inf>) has in the order of 5 MHz. The proposed LPF provides tunable facility by using controlling voltage of MOSFET without changing the value of any components. The functionality of proposed LPF is verified by using PSPICE simulation with 0.25μm TSMC CMOS technology parameters. The simulated validate the theoretical concept. Finally, the comparison study is also reported with existing one.

Author Keywords: Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistor (MOSFET)

articleTitle: Traffic Delay Analysis for Intelligent Transportation System using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: With the advancement in vehicular technology and automotive industry, Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) focuses on the safety and comfort of road users. The transportation system faces a key challenge of increase in road crashes, with the substantial growth in the count of vehicles on roads. Road accidents not only increase the risk for vulnerable road users but also lead to traffic delays or congestion. The amount of traffic delay is dependent on the severity of the accident. In this paper, we have implemented a Dense Neural Network (DNN) for the classification of road accidents according to their impact on traffic delays. Four classes (Class 1, 2, 3, and 4) have been identified on the basis of the severity of road accidents. Class 1 refers to the least severe accidents resulting in short traffic delays and Class 4 refers to the accidents resulting in long traffic delays. Different machine learning classification algorithms have been implemented. Further, 1-layer, 2-layer, and 4-layer DNN has been implemented. The results of machine learning algorithms and DNN have been compared using recall, precision, accuracy, and F1-score. It is evident from the results that 4-layer DNN resulted in a stable and precise outcome.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Multifunctional Convertible Electric Wheelchair using a Joystick
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: There are millions of people who are unable to walk independently due to variety of reasons including accidents, disabilities, aging etc. Therefore, designing an autonomous wheelchair that addresses the diverse needs of individuals with mobility challenges. This paper presents an electric wheelchair which is controlled by a joystick controller in Proteus software and designed in SolidWorks. The proposed electric wheelchair can be transformed into a stretcher, providing enhanced comfort for individuals during leisure activities and at night. The user experience is further improved by the hardware implementation of a prototype electric wheelchair with capabilities for adjusting the backrest and leg rests. The multifunctionality of the wheelchair not only enhances the quality of life for individuals but also facilitates better medical treatment. The integration of multifunctional features, along with user-friendly controls and cost-effectiveness, makes this electric wheelchair an efficient solution for enhancing mobility and improving the overall wellbeing of individuals with physical disabilities.

articleTitle: Decentralized Approach for Graduates’ Certificate Generation, Validation, and Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Education is undeniably a fundamental factor in the upgrade of society. However, the rise of counterfeit certifications has become a growing concern. With the increasing advancement of technology, fake hard copies of certificates and manipulated database duplicates have become more prevalent in our society. A potential solution to the issue at hand has been proposed in the form of a blockchain-based decentralized application. The proposed blockchain-based decentralized application offers a promising solution to address the growing issue of forgery. By leveraging this new technology, we can ensure that authentic digital records are appropriately stored, providing easy access and adapting evidence for rapid verification when needed. This program not only caters to students seeking to obtain their certificate but also helps educational institutions and recruiters.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation of the Use of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for Lung Cancer Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the “causes of death in developing countries”, and it is on the rise as a result of the massive raise in smoking tobacco. Tumours, immune response dysfunction, and other problems caused by cancerous cells can obstruct the body’s ability to function normally. Lung cancer is an abnormal tumour of the lungs that causes unregulated tumour growth in the organs. The “Artificial Neural Network or ANN” is utilised to detect the existence of lung cancer in the human body. ANN is a brand-new “Machine Learning (ML)” methodology that works with both small and large samples. An “artificial neural network (ANN)” is a statistical model based on the structure and performance of “natural neural networks In neural networks, there are input and output levels, as well as hidden layer that turn the input into something that the output unit can use (in most circumstances). The major purpose of this study is to use characteristics, which are a set of human features and data, to indicate the existence of lung cancer cells. The study investigates if an Artificial Neural Network framework can be used to detect the existence of lung cancer in a person’s body. Both primary quantitative and secondary qualitative research methods are considered to develop in depth analysis.

articleTitle: Issues and Solution of Distance Protection of Grid Integrated with Solar PV plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The integration of large scale solar plants into transmission network is growing in Megawatt size every year. Distance Protection of the transmission lines is affected with the large integration of solar plants. In this paper, the distance protection issue in such transmission lines integrating solar plants with grid is discussed. The performance of distance relay in a two-bus test system is analyzed in MATLAB Simulink software with a BCG fault at 70% of length of line from PV plant bus. It is found that the distance relay starts maloperating when the value of fault resistance is 40 $\Omega$ or higher value. With the modified relay coordinates, the apparent impedance detected at the relay location lies inside its first zone characteristics and the relay is able to detect the fault.

articleTitle: Short - Term Load Forecasting for IEEE 33 Bus Test System using SARIMAX
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Load forecasting plays a crucial role in energy management, providing accurate predictions of electricity demand to optimize resource allocation, grid stability, and economic efficiency. This study investigates the use of the Seasonal Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Variables (SARIMAX) model for load forecasting. The SARIMAX model combines the conventional SARIMA model with exogenous variables, allowing the addition of external factors like weather, holidays, and economic indices that affect power usage. In comparison to conventional SARIMA models, the SARIMAX model improves forecasting accuracy by taking these factors into account, particularly in scenarios with large external impacts. The SARIMAX model for load forecasting is implemented and evaluated in this study. The SARIMAX model is trained and optimized using historical load data and pertinent exogenous variables. The best model parameters are found using a variety of methods, including grid search and cross-validation.

articleTitle: Multi-Domain Active Learning for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Multi-domain active learning (MDAL) is the process of simultaneously learning a number of models, each of which is specialized to execute a task in a certain domain, in order to decrease labeling effort by only utilizing the most useful data. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-domain active learning for multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) approach. The primary objective of the proposed approach is to enable learning with substantially less user input and provide users with the freedom to explore multiple possibilities in order to find the optimal strategy to maximize their reward. We employ the StarCraft 2 (SC2) learning environment to evaluate the effectiveness of our algorithm when comparing it with cutting-edge approaches. Our research results show that the recommended approach works better in all scenarios.

articleTitle: Prediction of Thermal Conductivity and Heat Capacity of PAN and PEG Copolymers Composite using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In this investigation, the BIOVIA material studio was used to evaluate the PAN/PEG composite. The composite's thermal conductivity and heat capacity were measured, and the root mean square error was predicted using the ANN model in the Synthia module of the BIOVIA application. The composite's thermal conductivity and heat capacity were evaluated throughout a range of polyethylene glycol mass fractions, from 0% to 1%. Compared to the pure material, the composite's thermal conductivity increased by 46%, and its heat capacity increased by 9.4% when PEG made up 1% of the mass fraction. Thermal conductivity and heat capacity data were taken in a dry laboratory and then analyzed using a bi-layer artificial neural network (ANN). The ANN's thermal conductivity and heat capacity estimates held up throughout testing. The implemented ANN modeled Both attributes well, with a Mean Squared Log Error of 1.29 and 14.46, respectively

articleTitle: Talk House a Drop-in Audio Webapp: A cross between a podcast and a conference call
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Talk House is a social networking webapp that has features like conference calls, talkback radio, audio podcast, and an online audio chat. Unlike other social networks, it allows real-time streaming audio chats without users needing to share any additional information such as text messages, videos, or photos. Users can listen to and participate in real-time conversations, as well as create their own discussions. Talk House is positioned as an exclusive and alternative social network that attracts celebrities and people who want to connect with others. It provides a platform for digital group therapy where people could discuss their problems with strangers. Despite the rise of uninterrupted communication through social media, there is a need for academic research into the reasons for the growing popularity of sound-based applications. This study is based on qualitative research methods to explore the grounds for people's use of these technologies and their underlying motivation. The paper examines the possible driving forces behind the creation of Talk House, reveals its true intentions, and assesses three possible scenarios for its future development.

articleTitle: Advancements in Hand Health Management: Real-Time Monitoring and Assessment with a Wearable Sensory Glove
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This work presents the design and implementation of an innovative soft and wearable sensory glove for the hand, capable of measuring the force applied by the fingers and the angle at the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints. For individuals undergoing hand rehabilitation training, the proposed sensory glove can provide real-time feedback on force exertion during exercises, facilitating progress monitoring and necessary adjustments to the rehabilitation process. Active collection of sensory data assists healthcare professionals in better analyzing various distinct hand functions and development of personalized treatment plans. By continuously monitoring finger force and joint angles, abnormal patterns or changes that may indicate the onset of conditions like carpal tunnel syndrome or arthritis can be identified. Moreover, the sensory glove promotes preventive measures by encouraging better hand ergonomics during daily activities.

articleTitle: Computation Analysis of Multi-Class Plant Disease Diagnosis using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Horticulture is the art of cultivating fruits and vegetables, forming the base of both health and business. Despite replacing traditional methods, plant monitoring and disease diagnosis have even been the primary focus of modern-day farming as plant disease ignorance comes with monetary loss. Horticulture heading towards industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) 5.0 comes with smart methodologies to identify and treat plant diseases. With this objective, this paper emphasizes identifying a model which can well diagnose plant disease by diagnosing plant leaves with a high accuracy level. Three models namely ResNet50, DenseNet-161, and Inception V3 using Logistic Regression classifier have been compared based on the plant leaf image data set. Accuracy achieved for each model were Resnet-50 (96.9%), Densenet-161 (92.8%) and Inception Net V3 (90.2%) out of which Resnet-50 outperforms the other two.

Author Keywords: plant leaf disease diagnosis deep learning

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Sentiment Analysis on Drug Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has emerged as a crucial tool. Analyzing drug reviews offers useful insights on user perceptions and experiences with treatments in the field of pharmaceuticals. In order to understand the underlying feelings and emotions of consumers in the healthcare industry and conduct sentiment analysis on medicine reviews, this study applies sophisticated natural language processing (NLP) methods. The study uses an enormous database composed of medication reviews that were obtained from a number of widely used websites. To ensure reliable sentiment analysis results, the textual input is cleaned and tokenized using NLP preparation techniques. Deep learning and machine learning techniques were employed to classify evaluations as favorable, negative, or neutral. To examine how people feel about medicine reviews, we are using LSTM and BiLSTM methods with an accuracy of 85.12% and 89.3%, respectively.

articleTitle: Transient Thermal Analysis on Li-ion Battery Pack used for Evs using Comsol
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Lithium-ion (Li-ion) batteries stand out as a promising power source for electric and hybrid vehicles due to their high energy capacity, minimal self-discharge, lightweight nature, durability and absence of certain drawbacks. However, the substantial heat they generate can obstruct the performance and pose safety risks. Therefore the prediction of temperature developed on the cell surface is most important. The objective of the research is to predict the temperature developed on each cell of Lithium-ion battery pack using COMSOL multi physics software. The battery pack is designed and developed to produce 0.384 kW power during the discharge. The acquired experimental data from the tests is employed to create a graph illustrating the relationship between voltage and temperature. Three dimensional model of the battery pack was created and tetrahedral mesh was created for computational analysis. The battery pack is anticipated to reach a peak temperature of 62°C, and a rapid decline in voltage during discharge is observed between the 0.1 to 0.15-hour timeframe. It was noticed that The temperature is supposed to rise by 13.6 degrees Celsius as the battery voltage decreases from 23.7 V to 10.7 V.

articleTitle: Performance review of a PSO trained ANN based MPPT in a Grid-connected 3MW Solar Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This article provides a simplified model of a 3MWp grid-connected solar photovoltaic plant to assess the plant’s performance under various irradiance and temperature circumstances. Two types of MPPT controllers are designed here. One is based on P&O technology and the other is based on ANN-based MPPT controller with PSO algorithm. The Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, which depends on each individual and its neighbors at each step, was inspired by the behavior of animals like fish flocking or bird schooling etc. The main idea of using the PSO algorithm is to estimate the ANN model efficiently and accurately by reducing the computation time. The performance of the plant in both methods has been evaluated through MATLAB SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Bidirectional DC-DC Converter Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Recent advances in energy storage electric vehicles, renewable energy systems, etc. require a variety of features from a highly functional DC-DC converter. Among different topology configurations, bidirectional ones are used because of their reduced weight, size, and cost-effectiveness. A review of each bidirectional group converter has been addressed here based on advantages, disadvantages, voltage gain, characteristics, efficiency, and power density along with their typical application. The decision will make a ground of comparison for producing new topology and finding the appropriate converter for the specific application for the researchers.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Model for Saffron Cultivation and Growth Parameter Analysis and Monitoring by Using AquaCrop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized modern life to a great extent. The impact of IoT on agriculture has resulted in increased crop yield and better quality. Numerous issues related to saffron cultivation like area specific cultivation, adulteration, lack of a technology-based model can also be addressed by using IoT. The paper presents a study of different IoT based techniques for cultivation of crops. A smart IoT based model for saffron cultivation has also been proposed. The model has been validated by using Pearson coefficient for comparison of actual percentage growth with predicted values. The values of R obtained for temperature and humidity constants is 0.967 and 0.884 which indicate good performance as compared to other existing models. The values of R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> obtained is 0.935 and 0.782 which shows that the quality of model is better in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Efficient Power Generation In Electric Vehicles: A Chain Gear Ratio Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This research work explores the concept of generating electricity using the chain between the front and back wheel of an electric vehicle. The study focuses on the interplay between mechanical and electrical systems and the multi-step process of converting mechanical energy into electrical energy. The fundamental principles of gear ratios are examined, and the appropriate gear ratio for generating the desired output speed and torque is selected. The study also investigates the connection of a dynamo or generator to the chain and the optimal speed and torque range required for maximum electrical output. The generated electrical power can be used to recharge the battery bank of the electric vehicle, thereby extending its range. The research highlights the importance of careful engineering design and selection of the appropriate gear ratio and dynamo to ensure system efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Regression Model to Predict Health Insurance Claim
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In today’s world, where there are a lot of accidents and disasters happening, there is a need for a huge amount of money for health care as the cost of treatments and medicines requirements are very high. There are many cases where people can’t afford the treatment and lose their life. To prevent this, government along with many private banks tied up with numerous hospitals to set up many insurance agencies. People deposit some amount of money in the bank on a monthly or yearly basis in return for which the insurance agency provides money as health insurance. Costs of health insurance throughout the globe have increased critically in recent times. The increased trend results in the requirement of quick decision-making while providing better accuracy. This paper deals with the prediction regarding claiming health insurance i.e., whether a person claims his/her health insurance based on different factors. Using human brains for prediction agencies faces different errors which often results in extra administrative effort for reworking and finally leads to very little accuracy. Machine Learning algorithms can be the alternatives for the above-said problems as they can handle huge amounts of data. In this paper, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Decision Trees (DT), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Logistic Regression Models (LRM) are applied to the dataset. The DT shows the best accuracy among all the applied algorithms.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stock Price Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The paper presents a study on stock price prediction using a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model and other machine learning techniques like Random Forest (RF). The LSTM model was trained on historical stock price data and technical indicators to forecast future stock prices accurately. Evaluation metrics demonstrate the LSTM model's superior predictive accuracy compared to benchmark models. The findings highlight the potential of LSTM and machine learning for stock price prediction, offering implications for financial analysts and traders. The results show that both RF and LSTM can predict stock prices reasonably, with LSTM performing slightly better than RF. Through LSTM, R2=0.99, MSE=0.029, RMSE=0.49 has been calculated. The work suggests that deep learning methods such as LSTM can be a promising approach for stock price prediction, especially when dealing with complex and noisy data.

articleTitle: Outlier Detection System for Cardiovascular disease using Time-Series Data: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Traditional approaches to disease diagnosis and prognosis are cumbersome and prone to error. Cardiovascular illness is extremely serious and needs to be handled by qualified healthcare professionals. Any small error causes huge problems. Using the conventional methods, it is extremely difficult to diagnose and forecast cardiovascular disease in its early stages. Artificial intelligence has the power to solve a wide range of issues in a variety of fields, with healthcare being one of the most promising. The most reliable approach for assessing the performance and health of the cardiovascular system, as well as for detecting disorders related to it, is electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. The arrhythmias that are represented by ECG patterns are irregular heartbeats. A growing amount of the ECG arrhythmia signal needs to be automated for classification and identification in order to produce quicker and more accurate findings. To evaluate the efficacy and accuracy of the outlier detection method over benchmark datasets towards the model, the Arrhythmia dataset and the PTB abnormal normal dataset were used in this work.

articleTitle: Power Factor Improvement using PWM Rectifier in Shrink Fitting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Induction Heating (IH) systems are a popular choice for an extensive range of applications in the automotive industry. However, the input power factor is poor in conventional IH systems, which leads to higher input current. Therefore, a single switch resonant inverter with a PWM rectifier as its input is considered in the work presented. This work validates the power factor improvement of an IH system that can be used in the automotive industry, specifically for shrink fitting. PWM rectifier is implemented in the IH system, replacing diode bridge rectifier, and it is observed that both distortion and displacement power factor are improved. In order to generate pulses for the controllable switches in the PWM rectifier, hysteresis current control method is used. Prior to this selection, various types of closed-loop current control methods were analyzed, and hysteresis current control, employing a single PI controller, is selected for the closed-loop operation. A low power level laboratory prototype is constructed and tested successfully, and results are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Smart Adaptive Headlight System for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Adaptive Light system are technically advanced illumination system in Automobile industries whose design and operation are comparatively simpler and cheaper than the advanced lighting system, which can reduce the risk of accidents during night timer by providing proper illumination on the road. They are also coupled with a dimmer circuit which can automatically adjust the intensity level and angle (occasionally switching the Active or Inactive state) based on the necessity and design which cannot blind the opposing cars which are in the right lane of the road. The major goal of this work is to prevent accidents from happening at night because of poor lighting conditions, especially at road corners. It also aims to develop and construct a straightforward steering-controlled automated lamp system. This type is integrated into an automobile’s front and steering systems, assisting in maintaining the constant alignment of the front wheels and headlamp parts. So, this prototype is created to prevent poor visibility and ineffective road lighting. Two subsystems, including headlamp angle control and lighting intensity control, are integrated into it. The movement of headlight with respect to steering position is being controlled here through wireless communication which helps alleviating the inadequate illumination situation.

articleTitle: Data Communication Strategies in Networked Control Systems – A Journey towards Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
