abstract: An industrial process control system comprises sensors, controllers, and actuators, essential for maintaining the overall process. These fundamental components are interconnected through a dedicated network, forming networked control systems widely utilized in process automation. Communication among sensors, actuators, and a local controller is facilitated by various protocols such as foundation fieldbus and Modbus. The networked control systems primarily involve two types of communication: periodic and aperiodic, enabling the transmission of control and information data across the network. This paper focuses on reviewing networked control systems to enhance their application in the context of Industry 4.0. The challenges associated with data transmission, including delay time, network access time, and bandwidth assessment, are examined based on existing literature. Moreover, the possibilities of integrating information within traditional networks are explored, shedding light on the potential of Industry 4.0. This paper aims to provide insights into the network coverage across multiple domains, facilitating improved process monitoring through efficient data transmission.

articleTitle: A Series-Parallel Input Parallel Output Based Active Clamped Current-Fed DC-DC Converter For High Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This work presents a series-parallel input parallel output (SPIPO) based active clamped current-fed DC-DC converter topology, which is capable of to operate at medium voltage level at input side and can be employed for high power applications. The presented DC-DC converter provides galvanic isolation and provides ZVS (zero voltage switching) operation to primary side switches and ZCS (zero current switching) operation to the rectifier diodes present on the secondary side of the high-frequency transformer. The presented system reduces the input and output filter size because of interleaving operation and hence provides a compact and highly efficient DC-DC converter. The presented work was implemented on MATLAB software and was tested at various duty ratio operating conditions of the presented DC-DC converter.

Author Keywords: SPIPO based Active clamped current-fed DC-DC converter

articleTitle: Solar Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting using LSTM and SARIMAX model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In several areas of load forecasting and throughout the years, energy management has concentrated on artificial intelligence (AI). In several circumstances, time series forecasting models have been developed. In this study, two separate models, Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous factors (SARIMAX) and Long Short-Term Memory Loss (LSTM), are used to forecast solar photovoltaic (PV) generation, which involves several variables. As a result, the data utilized in this work is real-time data from NREL. To solve these issues, the data has been used to train a range of deep learning and machine learning models, and the outcomes provide novel insights on the benefits and need of integrating exogenous components in a time series model. Additionally, forecasting mistakes are evaluated using short-term prediction updates. Their analysis demonstrates how accurate their model is.

articleTitle: Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller in Three Area System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In power systems, the control of the frequency and voltage is critical to maintain the power balance and ensure stable operation. The Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller is a robust and effective control technique that has been applied in various power systems. This paper proposes the implementation of the Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller in a three-area power system to improve the system’s performance in terms of frequency and voltage control. The simulation is carried out in MATLAB, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control approach in regulating the system’s frequency and voltage in response to different disturbances. The proposed controller’s performance is compared to the conventional PID controller, and it is shown that the Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller outperforms the conventional controller in terms of settling time and overshoot. The study also analyzes the effect of various parameters of the Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller, such as the inertia constant and gain parameters, on the system’s performance. The results demonstrate that the Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller can effectively regulate the system’s frequency and voltage, and it can be a viable option for improving the performance of power systems. Overall, this paper provides valuable insights into the application of the Grasshopper Tuned PID Controller in power systems and highlights its potential benefits for future power system control applications.

articleTitle: Experimental Self-Discharge Performance of Supercapacitor for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The rising demand for renewable energy sources has led to an increased need for energy storage systems. Supercapacitors (SCs) have garnered growing attention because of their high power density, extended cycle life, rapid recharge capabilities, and minimal maintenance requirements. However, their use in various applications is held up by severe self-discharge behaviors, particularly in various commercial energy storage applications. Self-discharge behaviour is an important consideration for the application of SCs in electric vehicles (EVs). When an SC is stored in a charged state for an extended period, its self-discharge can significantly impact energy storage, power delivery, and recharging frequency. So the study and understanding of self-discharge is crucial for optimizing the performance and efficiency of SCs in EVs. The decrease of open-circuit potential difference across the terminals of SC refers to measuring the voltage decay of an SC over time. This method provides insights into the self-discharge kinetics and the rate of energy loss. Understanding these mechanisms can provide insights into the underlying processes and help design strategies to minimize self-discharge. In this paper, the self-discharge behavior of SC is compared with Li-ion battery.

articleTitle: Fine Tuning Auto Regressive LLMs for Long Document Abstractive Summarization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Generating a short summary from a long document is a challenging task, for which new language models are still being designed and trained based on the available data. Since deep learning models are used for NLP and NLG applications, it requires high computational power to train these models. Further, fine-tuning the weights based on a given context is an important task that needs additional computation space and time. In this paper, we have used Cerebras’ wafer-scale cluster that aims at providing an efficient software and hardware infrastructure that enhances the capabilities of pre-existing models and empowers them to handle lengthy documents well. In addition to analyzing common models along with their pros and cons, other factors such as the context lengths and model sizes have also been analyzed to accommodate lengthy documents as much as possible.

articleTitle: SOGI-ANF Filter based Micro Grid with Solar Water Pumping System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This paper presents a solar water pumping system driven by a PMSM (Permanent Synchronous Magnet Motor) integrated with the grid and powered by solar energy. This technique is being proposed as a way to continuously run a WPS (Water Pumping System) with better power quality irrespective of solar insolation variations. In order to create such a system, the DC link is integrated into a VSC (Voltage Source Converter) for utility grid control and a VSI (Voltage Source Inverter) for PMSM control. Additionally, the power flow between a solar PV system and the associated utility grid is managed using unit vector template theory. A filter technique, i.e., a “SOGI-ANF filter” based control method, is utilized to filter the harmonics and the DC offset of the grid currents and forecast the synchronizing signal components. Further, in order to extract maximum power from the solar PV array, an incremental conductance MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) technique is employed, and the speed of the PMSM is controlled via sensor-less vector control. The proposed system is simulated on MATLAB Simulink and was tested on several anomalies, and the responses were found to be well within the IEEE-519 Standard norms.

articleTitle: Estimation of Power Losses in Interleaved Buck-Boost Converter for EV Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) market is increasing drastically. Some of the main concerns of EVs are charging the batteries and driving range issues. Additionally, the battery charger is regarded as the fundamental technology. Therefore, the designing of an efficient charger for EV batteries may resolve the charging issues and strengthen the EV infrastructure. An interleaved buck-boost converter (IBBC) is elaborated in detail in this study. The power loss modeling is presented in detail including different modes of operations. Further, the simulation studies are carried out with the help of MATLAB version 2015a to validate the theoretical findings. Finally, the efficiency analysis is also presented for both the operating modes i.e. buck and boost.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Optimized Hydro Governor Control action using GWO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Governor control action plays a critical role in ensuring stability and efficiency in power generation systems. Optimized governor action involves the careful refinement and utilization of advanced control techniques to enhance the performance of the governor control system. This abstract highlights the various benefits associated with optimized governor action, including improved system stability, increased efficiency, faster response time, reduced wear and tear, and enhanced flexibility. It underscores the importance of conducting thorough analysis and customization tailored to specific system requirements and objectives in order to successfully implement optimized governor action. The optimization of governor control action enables power systems to achieve enhanced stability, efficiency, and overall performance, leading to decreased energy consumption and prolonged equipment lifespan.

articleTitle: Assessment of Performance and Characteristics of a Hybrid Charging Scheme for Electric Vehicle Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The primary objective of this paper is to employ a Hybrid Charging approach to optimize and enhance the efficiency of electric vehicle (EV) battery charging. This innovative technology integrates various charging methods solar-based charging, wind-based charging, and plug-in charging systems -'within a single car unit. To evaluate the performance and characteristics of this battery charging scheme, the MATLAB/SIMULINK has been opted. With the simulation results, the authors have reported different performance characteristics, including Percentage (%) State of Charge (SOC) of battery vs time, rectified voltage vs wind speed, line voltage vs wind speed, and battery discharging voltage vs time for different schemes. The plug-in charging method outperforms than others two charging scheme, adapting smartly EV battery status. This hybrid approach accelerates EV adoption, fostering eco-friendly transportation.

articleTitle: IoT applications in Modern Supply Chains: Enhancing Efficiency and Product Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: the Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized supply chain management in recent years. IoT-based systems have made it possible for more efficient tracking and communication, improved inventory management, and better visibility and control with real-time data now available at all levels. Furthermore, the use of sensors and other technological tools such as RFID tags can also lead to improved product quality by allowing for more efficient monitoring and investigation of each step of the supply chain. IoT has enhanced the overall efficiency of supply chain management while allowing for the implementation of predictive maintenance techniques. These techniques help to identify potential problems before they happen, reducing the resulting downtime of production and shipments. Moreover, IoT-supported processes enable an efficient real-time response to changing conditions such as weather, demand levels, or customer needs. In the end, this leads to improved operational efficiency, less waste, and greater customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: An intelligent optimization framework to predict the vulnerable range of tumor cells using Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The intelligent optimization framework for predicting the vulnerable range of tumor cells using Internet of Things (IoT) provides a robust and efficient solution for monitoring, assessing, and managing cancer treatment. This framework is based on a combination of deep learning algorithms, big data analytics, cloud computing, and IoT technology. The main purpose of this framework is to develop an optimal solution for detecting the vulnerable range of tumor cells using the latest advances in image processing, machine learning and natural language processing. This framework collects data from various medical or health-related sources such as patient records, imaging results, and medical reports and stores them on the cloud. It filters real-time data at micro-levels to generate a more accurate analysis of the vulnerable range of tumor cells in order to make better proactive healthcare decisions. In this framework, the deep learning algorithms are used to develop predictive models that can accurately detect the vulnerable range of tumor cells. The big data analytics platform is used to analyze the collected data patterns for more refined predictions. Finally, the cloud computing technology provides a distributed computing platform to take advantage of the data from different sources. By integrating the latest advances in machine learning, natural language processing, and cloud computing, the intelligent optimization framework for predicting the vulnerable range of tumor cells using IoT provides an efficient and accurate solution for optimizing the diagnosis and treatment of cancer, enabling doctors to provide better proactive care to their patients.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Automated Lesion Detection in Mammography
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Deep learning for automated lesion detection in mammography has gained widespread attention due to its potential to reduce the time needed for radiologists to detect lesions accurately. Deep learning models are now being widely used in automated lesion detection in digital mammography. These models are able to classify suspicious regions that refer to symptoms of breast cancer better than classical image processing techniques. However, traditional models are limited by the lack of large public datasets that are representative of the variety of lesions that can exist in mammograms. Recent works have proposed deep learning models trained on large public datasets such as Digital Database for Screening Mammography (DDSM) and Digital Mammographic Image Archive (MI-AMI) that have achieved promising performance. These deep learning models use imaging and anatomical information for lesion detection, which results in better performance than classical approaches. Future research could extend the use of deep learning by exploring new vector-based approaches, integrating more data from mammography and clinic specialties, and performing holistic analyses to gain better insights..

articleTitle: A Comprehensive analysis of Network Coding for Efficient Wireless Network Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In the current generation of wireless networks, network coding has become popular for efficient communication of data over the wireless network. The network coding technique enables efficient communication of data by decreasing the latency in the network and improving the throughput of the network. The aim of this paper is to provide a comprehensive analysis of the performance of network coding techniques in wireless networks in order to achieve reliable and efficient communication. This paper provides an overview of the network coding techniques used in wireless networks and evaluates them in terms of latency, reliability and throughput. Finally, the paper offers some concluding remarks and future directions for research. Overall, this paper provides a comprehensive insight and analysis of the use of network coding techniques for efficient communication over wireless networks.

articleTitle: Improving Speech Privacy with Fuzzy Logic-Based Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Speech privacy is a critical concern in today’s interconnected world, where speech processing technologies are becoming increasingly prevalent. Traditional encryption techniques may not be sufficient to protect sensitive information in speech data due to the unique characteristics of speech signals. This research paper explores the application of fuzzy logic-based encryption to enhance speech privacy. Fuzzy logic offers a flexible and adaptive approach to encryption, accommodating the inherent uncertainty and variability present in speech signals. The study investigates the effectiveness of fuzzy logic-based encryption in safeguarding speech data and compares it with conventional encryption methods. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of fuzzy logic-based encryption in preserving speech privacy, highlighting its potential for securing speech processing systems and applications.

articleTitle: MIFS Ordered Weighted Operators method for renewable-energy-source-selection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In order to choose the most effective renewable energy source (RES), one needs make use of a sophisticated multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) strategy. This is required since there are many aspects that must be taken into consideration. This endeavour is made more difficult by the existence of contradictory standards as well as insufficient and incorrect information. In order to address these unpredictabilities, the concept of moderator-intuitionistic-fuzzy-set (IFS), or MIFS for short, has been developed as an extension of IFSs. Additionally, the MIFS contributes to the achievement of a higher degree of accuracy in the prediction of unanticipated behaviors brought on by the moderator parameter (MP). As a result of this study, we have developed a strategy that may be used to choose the best RES to work inside the MIFS framework. Under MIFS information, we suggest a new aggregation operator that we call the MIF ordered weighted averaging (MIOWA) operator and the MIF ordered weighted geometric (MIOWG) operator. Both of these operators are based on the MIFS information. In conclusion, we provide a strategy for overcoming challenges associated with RES selection that makes use of the operator that we built.

articleTitle: Constant Power Loads in DC Microgrids: A Review of Modern Nonlinear Control Approaches and Stabilisation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In recent dc microgrids (dcMGs), the naval motors and hotel loads are constantly powered by point of load converters these are precisely regulated, which perform as constant power loads (CPL). One of the most important CPL’s characteristics is the negative incremental impedance, it decreases effective damping of the system, which leads to instability of the whole system, and this is a significant challenge in the system operation and control. This behavior tends to destabilize the dc bus voltage of dcMGs under uncertain environments. To stabilize as well as control the CPL of dc micro grids, the robust control of the dc bus voltage is essential. This article presents a cutting-edge comprehensive review on sophisticated nonlinear control techniques of Sliding Mode Control, Predictive Control, Back-Stepping Control, and Passivity-Based Control. This review paper addresses the modeling aspects, CPL characteristics and their impacts. It also addresses the most recent stabilization methods as well as emerging developments towards adaptive nonlinear control.

articleTitle: Auto Signal Generate in Curvy Roads Using Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Sharp turns or dangerous roadway bends cause most car accidents today. These vehicle accidents usually cause death or permanent disability. Reckless driving on curves causes many fatal car accidents. The double-bend, S-curve, hairpin bend, sharp-turn, and others are dangerous road bends. Hairpin turns are more dangerous if drivers don’t honk to warn other drivers. Even if drivers fail to honk the horn, the system will automatically send a signal to cars coming from the other direction to minimize the likelihood of an accident on hairpin turns. A radio carrier wave with a frequency between 300 and 600 MHz modifies the sound signal and is generated when an object detector detects a warning road sign. The adjusted audio signal is subsequently sent through the antenna. Detecting a transmitter signal is simplified when both the sender and the receiver exclusively use channel ‘0’ for communication and ignore information on any other channels. Once the receiving antenna has picked up the modified signal, the decoder can separate the audio signal from the radio carrier wave. When the receiver pinpoints the signal’s source, an alarm and an LED light flash to alert drivers to the potential threat.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence for Pedestrian Detection in IoV: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Internet of Vehicles (IoV), is the internet on wheels having sensors, On Board Units (OBUs), and users to create a communication network. The IoV lessens road fatalities, pedestrian deaths, traffic jams, and road congestion. These applications significantly improve the development of Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) and increase the transportation efficiency, safety, and global value of automobiles. Therefore, to assure the safety of pedestrians and decrease the risk of accidents, pedestrian detection in IoV plays a significant role. This paper provides detailed insights into existing research on pedestrian detection techniques and the role of pedestrian detection in IoV. Furthermore, a comparison between traditional, deep learning-based, and hybrid approaches has been discussed with its advantages and limitations.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for Noise Elimination of Partial Discharge Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Noises can contaminate acoustic partial discharge (PD) signals, resulting in inaccurate detection and interpretation. As a result, denoising acoustic PD signals has achieved significant attention to enable precise diagnosis and analysis. This manuscript presents a deep learning (DL) method for denoising acoustic PD signals obtained from a high-voltage power apparatus. The obtained signals are contaminated with various levels of white Gaussian noises followed by two-dimensional time-frequency transformation via continuous wavelet transform (CWT). The CWT images are then fed to a fully convolutional network (FCN) based autoencoder (AE), that supports skip connections, to perform denoising on the acoustic PD signals. The proposed FCN based AE is validated upon four mother wavelets, and it has been observed that the best performance is achieved for the ‘Daubechies’ wavelet. Moreover, the denoising performance has been assessed using various evaluation metrics, where different levels of white Gaussian noises are added. Experimental results reveal that the proposed denoising method outperforms the existing DL quantitatively. The proposed scheme can also be used to monitor and diagnose other signal modalities in real time.

articleTitle: Green IoT for Sustainable Smart Vertical Farming: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Environmental sustainability is promoted with the building of IoT-enabled smart technologies. This sustainability is promoted by optimized power consumption and minimizing waste and carbon emissions by reusing and recycling products. Despite being advantageous in many aspects, IoTs produce and transmit humungous data, thereby increasing cumulative energy consumption while propagating through any network. These in turn create issues in environmental sustainability, issues with the responsible use of resources, and reduce waste production, which brings about the need to address the future challenge of IoTs by developing processes and policies to reduce carbon emission and further optimize IoT greenhouse effect. Greening of IoTs is the solution to these issues which focuses on manufacturing energy-efficient IoT hardware as well as green software development. IoT plays a vital role in the automatization of vertical farming methods. The smart and intelligent capability of IoTs facilitates better and faster yield of agricultural produce. The extensive use of IoTs in this sector also plays a major role in increasing greenhouse emissions and carbon footprint. Thus, the IoTs when replaced with Green IoTs (G–IoTs), especially in the agricultural sector, help in enhancing a two-way sustainability: environmental, in terms cleaner environment, as well as agricultural, in terms of better and faster agricultural produce.

articleTitle: An enhanced Active Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Robotics in Industrial automation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: An enhanced active reinforcement learning technique has been proposed to enable autonomous robots to operate and execute tasks in industrial automation. This approach combine hierarchical reinforcement learning and Bayesian optimization, to acquire knowledge from complex real-world environments and acquire optimal policies which can enable autonomous robots to perform collaborative tasks efficiently. The main advantage of this enhanced active reinforcement learning approach is the capability of the autonomous robot to autonomously adapt its movements and decision-making strategies when new tasks are required. It allows for the robot to explore its environment and learn how to complete tasks optimally while reducing the burden of manual intervention. Moreover, the proposed approach can generalize its knowledge to establish rewarding collaborative behaviors between robots and humans, thus allowing for collaborative human-robot interactions. This will be beneficial in performing industrial automation with robot cooperative tasks and optimize the efficiency of the industrial automation system..

articleTitle: Electromyography (EMG) Signal based Knee Abnormality Prediction using XGBoost Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: When diagnosing illness, assessing sports injuries, and rehabilitating patients, Surface Electromyography (sEMG) signals play a crucial role. In this study, we use the machine learning technique extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) to detect knee abnormalities. Four primary sequential steps involved in predicting knee abnormality for a publicly available dataset with 22 subject’s sEMG signals were recorded from three different lower-limb muscles while they are walking, sitting, and standing activities where 11 appeared healthy and 11 had knee abnormalities based on clinical assessment. First, we apply wavelet denoising the sEMG signals to eliminate noise and apply segmentation with a window size of 256 ms, overlapped it by 25%. In the third stage, feature extraction is done using Time Domain(TD), later feature reduction method using principal component analysis (PCA). Finally, a machine learning algorithm is used to predict lower limb knee abnormalities. In this research, various Machine Learning models are implemented for prediction, like SVM, Naive Bayes, XGBoost, and KNN, where the XGBoost classifier gives a good accuracy of 96% compared to another classifier.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things and Machine learning in improving supply chain financial risk management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The incorporation of the Internet of Things (IoT) and machine learning (ML) methods has attracted significant interest in a variety of sectors in previous years. This article investigates the use of IoT and ML to improve supply chain financial (SCF) threat management. The supply chain is a complicated network with many key players, and financial threat management is important to its sustainability and success. IoT and ML possess inherent advantages in SCF due to their technology properties. They also have significant opportunities to build trust to solve big challenges in SCF, which aids financial development in the Tonkin Gulf area. This paper focuses on introducing the study on using Machine learning innovation in SCF in the Tonkin Gulf area and aims to offer suggestions on how supply chain finance could evolve there using Machine learning. This paper suggests supply chain finance game applications for pertinent investigations as well as blockchain innovation, supply chain banking threats assessment on the IoT and machine learning, and supply chain finance implementation study methodologies in the Tonkin Gulf region.

articleTitle: A Review on Indian EV Adoption Policy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Across the globe, countries have set net-zero targets to handle adverse climatic changes. This can be achieved by ensuring zero carbon emissions from various sectors. The transportation sector is one of the major contributors to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Therefore, various countries, like India, have set ambitious targets to phase out fossil fuel-based vehicles and adopt electric vehicles (EVs). However, very little research offers an in-depth review of the policies and initiatives of governments in various countries, such as India. In this context, this paper offers in-depth reviews of the policies and initiatives of the Government of India (GoI) to adopt EVs. It also discusses the approaches used by the GoI to encourage the use of electric vehicles and develop a more sustainable and environmentally friendly transportation system. The review also identifies the role of the EV industry in addressing climate change and promoting sustainable mobility. The proposed review can provide useful information for stakeholders, researchers, and policymakers to promote the use of electric vehicles and a low-carbon transportation ecosystem in India.

articleTitle: Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm for Demand Side Management Incorporated Dynamic Economic Emission Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Toxic gases are released into the environment during electricity production by fossil fuel-powered generators. Along with encouraging the use of RES, power engineers also have a responsibility to find a compromise solution that will result in fewer hazardous gas emission when electricity is produced profitably. In order to address this challenge a numerical approach called environment constrained economic dispatch (ECED) yields a better-compromised solution among various techniques available. Demand side management, often known as DSM, is a tactic that is widely used in the industry of environmental engineering. DSM is primarily concerned with the optimisation of dispatchable loads in an effort to reduce overall energy consumption. It redistributes the load demand profile in such a way so as to lower the generation cost without curtailing the demand at any point. This paper implements a recently developed arithmetic optimization algorithm (AOA) to obtain a balance between minimum generation cost and pollutants both with and without the involvement of DSM. Numerical results claim the positive effects of DSM along with the superiority of AOA compared to some widely used algorithms in solving Dynamic Economic Emission Dispatch (DEED) problems.

articleTitle: Blockchain Security and Challenges: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Blockchain technology has emerged as a ground-breaking innovation with the potential to revolutionize various industries and transform transactions. Its decentralized platform allows for storing and trading digital assets without intermediaries. Robust security features such as immutability and cryptographic security deter data tampering or fraudulent activities through unique key codes. However, for successful widespread implementation across all industries, stakeholders must thoroughly understand its vulnerabilities. They need to consider specific security issues carefully and propose suitable solutions to enhance network protection. This review paper aims to critically examine the security aspects and challenges surrounding blockchain technology. By synthesizing existing literature and research findings, it offers comprehensive analysis insights into the inherent security concerns in blockchain implementations. Researchers can benefit from this consolidated resource by enriching their understanding of blockchain security, identifying knowledge gaps, and contributing to further advancements in the field. Additionally, practitioners and industry professionals can leverage the findings presented in this paper to gain a deeper comprehension of potential risks and vulnerabilities associated with blockchain technology. This empowers them to develop robust security strategies effectively mitigate threats.

articleTitle: An innovative analysis of Leveraging Transfer Learning for Accurate Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Transfer learning is a powerful technique used to leverage knowledge learned from one domain and transfer it to another domain, reducing the time needed to train a machine learning model. This paper presents a novel approach to apply transfer learning to improve accuracy in image recognition tasks. The authors first use classical transfer learning algorithms to analyze a publicly available image dataset and extract features relevant to the recognition problem. Then, they combine these extracted features with a convolutional neural network (CNN) to improve the classification accuracy of the CNN. The authors evaluate the performance of their approach using multiple datasets, such as MNIST and SVHN, and demonstrate the superiority in terms of high recognition accuracy, low memory requirements and fewer training iterations. The results show that the proposed approach outperforms the baseline CNNs, with an improvement of up to 10%. This approach could be used by research groups and computer vision systems that are concerned with accurate image recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Residential Energy Management System using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Residential Energy Management Systems (REMS) are emerging as a key solution to address energy efficiency and sustainability challenges in residential settings. Homeowners gain awareness of their energy consumption patterns, enabling them to make informed decisions and adopt energy-saving behaviors. REMS facilitate real-time feedback, helping individuals understand the impact of their actions on energy usage and promoting sustainable habits. Through intelligent control and coordination, homeowners can maximize the utilization of on-site solar panels or battery storage systems, reducing reliance on the grid and promoting clean energy generation. Based on the charging and discharging cycles, the REMS ensures the switching of loads to the storage systems energized by REGs, effectively. This paper uses Support Vector Machines (SVMs), and Machine Learning Algorithms (MLAs) to perform switching automation. This ensures a significant reduction in the grid-supplied power.

articleTitle: Intelligent Learning Methods for Load Frequency Control in Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Home energy management systems (HEMS) are to optimize the growing demand in the requirements of consuming energy with no compromise in consumer needs. The factor by which HEMSs operates is cost of energy consumed, reducing the peak load, environmental factors, etc. The load-frequency control (LFC) balances the generated power and load consumption by controlling frequency in each region. The purpose of LFC is minimization of the steady state error and transient disturbances, by means of control in each area it is used to balance both load and generation. LFC’s primary goal is to reduce transient deviations and steady state error to zero beforehand. This paper includes controls load power and frequency using a simple control structure for primary load management and tie line power transmission for secondary load management using MATLAB/SIMLINK. The transient and steady state performance of the control system is compared with Fuzzy Logic (FL), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN), Neuro Fuzzy (ANFIS), etc.

articleTitle: Classifying Diabetes Using Artificially Intelligent Techniques: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Today’s fast-paced, carefree lifestyle has led to an increase in illnesses. One of their primary health problems is diabetes. Half of all adults with diabetes go undiagnosed, despite the fact that the disease affects 1 in 10. Diabetes is a lifelong illness caused by the body’s inability to control blood sugar levels. It comes in two different varieties, type 1 and type 2. It’s a serious problem that needs being addressed. This paper discusses various machine learning algorithms such as logistic regression, naïve bayes, random forest, neural networks and adaboost, which helps in prediction of the same. The performance metrics taken into consideration are classification accuracy, precision, area under the curve, F1-score, and recall. The results obtained proves that the adaboost algorithm outperforms all the other machine learning algorithms taken into consideration.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for Hyperspectral Image Classification using PCA and Spectral LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Deep learning techniques, like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, have demonstrated remarkable performance in hyperspectral image (HSI) classification in recent years. This paper proposes a novel framework for the classification of hyperspectral images using a Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). PCA is basically used to minimize the high-dimensional image data, and then it send to LSTM for classification. LSTM is a RNN that is designed to perform better on sequential analysis of hyperspectral images. This proposed research and analysis of HIS data was performed on the standardized dataset of Pavia University and Kennedy Space Center (KSC). The proposed research framework effectively classifies the HIS images and shows its efficency in comparison to existing state-of-the-art classifiers. Overall, the proposed framework presents a promising approach to the classification of hyperspectral images by combining the strengths of LSTM and PCA. The paper contributes to the literature on hyperspectral image classification by demonstrating the effectiveness of deep learning models and the importance of considering the sequential nature of hyperspectral data.

articleTitle: Mitigating Truck Driver Fatigue: A Driver Sleepiness Detecting System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Sleep deprivation among truck drivers is a pervasive issue due to the demanding nature of their job, involving long hauls covering extensive distances both during the day and night. The resulting weariness and drowsiness significantly contribute to major accidents on roadways. A study conducted by the Central Road Research Institute (CRRI) revealed that fatigued drivers who fell asleep at the wheel caused 40% of traffic accidents on the 300 Km Agra-Lucknow Motorway in 2022, with Uttar Pradesh recording a high number of fatalities. These alarming statistics raise concerns about the apparent disregard for the importance of sufficient rest among Indian highway drivers, leading to life-threatening situations. In a nation where traffic accidents claim a life every three minutes, it has become paramount to find a viable solution. To address this pressing issue, we propose a novel driver sleepiness detecting system. This system is designed to recognize and alert drivers when they are drowsy or on the verge of falling asleep, thereby preventing potential accidents. By providing timely warnings and promoting increased awareness of their sleep status, this technology aims to mitigate the risks associated with fatigue-induced accidents, ultimately safeguarding lives and promoting road safety.

articleTitle: Solar Energy Monitoring and Management System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Solar Energy has the potential to significantly reduce our dependence on fossil fuels and mitigate the environmental impacts associated with conventional non-renewable energy resources. Building a solar power system for individual houses can be a great way to promote the use of renewable energy at the household level. However, managing the energy generated by solar panels may not always be sufficient to meet all the energy needs of a household. Integrating solar energy with conventional power supply and managing the electrical load effectively is a key challenge in maximizing the utilization of solar energy. This paper proposes an Internet of Things (IoT) based method for managing solar energy while supplying loads alongside conventional grid.This paper proposes a solar energy monitoring and management system that presents an innovative approach to optimize solar energy utilization, improve system performance, and contribute to sustainable energy management practices. The successful implementation of this work has the potential to bring significant environmental, social, and economic benefits, paving the way for a more sustainable and renewable energy landscape.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Approach for Reactive Power Management of Grid Connected Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This article introduces an enhanced mathematical approach for establishing the PQ capability curve of a grid-connected PV (GCPV) system. The main objective of this article is to efficiently manage the injection of reactive power into the electrical grid under maximum power point (MPP) conditions, taking into account the impact of varying weather conditions. The proposed approach involves evaluating all possible operating point within the stable region to ascertain the reactive power limitations of GCPV system. The proposed method involves assessing all feasible operational points within the stable range to establish the limits of reactive power provision for the GCPV system. Additionally, the strategy aims to increase the system’s reactive power capacity while ensuring that the PV inverter doesn’t exceed its thermal limits. To evaluate the effectiveness of this mathematical approach, simulations of the GCPV system were conducted using the real-time simulator OPAL-RT. These simulations employed an integrated closed-loop control strategy, encompassing controllers for DC-link voltage, maximum power point tracking (MPPT), and both active and reactive power.

articleTitle: A hybrid JAYA-SMA for demand side management based dynamic economic emission dispatch
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: When fossil fuel-powered generators produce electricity, toxic substances are emitted into the atmosphere. Power engineers have a duty to establish a compromise that would reduce dangerous gas emissions when electricity is produced profitably in addition to promoting the usage of Renewable Energy Sources (RES). Among the different combined economic emission dispatch (CEED) strategies available to solve this problem, a numerical approach termed as fractional programming (FP) method was used and compared with price penalty factor (PPF) method. The dispatchable loads are modelled using a technique known as demand side management (DSM). To reduce the cost of generation without ever reducing demand, it restructures the load demand profile. The Slime Mould Algorithm (SMA) was hybridized with JAYA and it is used in this research to achieve a balance between least generation cost and pollutants both with and without the involvement of Demand Side Management (DSM). Generation cost was minimized to ${\$}$78032 using JAYA algorithm. This value was further reduced to ${\$}$76757 using JAYA-SMA algorithm. Numerical data also suggest that the combined use of DSM and JAYA-SMA is superior to several commonly used algorithms in tackling dynamic economic emission dispatch problems.

articleTitle: A Review on Sensors and Technologies in Smart Farming Using AI and IoT Perspective and Their Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Smart farming’s aim is to enhance the general capabilities of traditional farming using advanced and latest technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), etc., and implementing it to industry-based technology for getting real-time information. A systematic approach to farm-based equipment needs to be used to increase production in agriculture as well as its quality. Smart farming is a low-labor and low-cost implementation method leading to an overall reduction of agricultural expenses. It helps to produce better quality and higher yield crops, leading to higher demand and prices, thus resulting in more profitability for farmers. The modern techniques of farming use technological instruments that are able to monitor environmental conditions suitable for a particular type of crop. These technological instruments offer numerous benefits, viz. increase in efficiency, cost reduction, and improvement in crop yields. Still, the implementation of the above technologies raises important social, ethical, and environmental concerns that need to be addressed. This paper focuses on various sensors and technologies deployed in smart farming. In addition, it highlights some of the challenges faced while implementing these technologies and their aftereffects.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches with Effective Feature Selection for Improving Breast Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Machine learning techniques enable systems to learn from experience and improve automatically without explicit programming. Machine learning techniques have proven efficient in many real-world applications. As the demand for accurate and reliable disease prediction systems rises in the medical field, numerous machine learning techniques are being employed for medical data analysis. The resulting models help medical practitioners make informed decisions. This paper explores the application of efficient machine learning approaches for medical data analysis and breast cancer prediction. Specifically, we employ classification algorithms to differentiate between cancerous and non-cancerous cells. The objective of this research is to determine the most suitable algorithm for cell classification and identify the algorithm that yields the best prediction output.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Empowered Weather Image Classification for Accurate Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Accurate weather classification is essential in numerous real-world applications, significantly impacting areas such as solar energy systems, outdoor events, and visual systems. For minimizing the adverse effects stemming from untimely weather fluctuations, its prediction is of utmost importance. The present work reflects an approach for multi-class weather classification by harnessing the power of deep learning techniques and transfer learning. The research utilizes the Multi-class Weather Dataset (MWD), comprising four weather conditions: sunrise, shine, rain, and cloudy. Using pre-trained deep learning architectures such as ResNet50, Densenet-161, InceptionV3, VGG19, and MobileNet, the present research extracts intricate features from the dataset images. Also, Transfer learning is employed to fine-tune these models for weather classification, effectively addressing the constraints posed by a scarcity of labeled data. The role of a logistic regression model is pivotal as the multi-class classifier. In-depth evaluation metrics encompassing accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score are employed, accompanied by a meticulous analysis utilizing confusion matrix techniques. The results show that Densenet-161 demonstrates superior performance while other models exhibit competitive results presenting viable alternatives for specific use cases. Overall, the study contributes insights into the effectiveness of pre-trained models and transfer learning in multi-class weather classification tasks.

articleTitle: Hyper Parameter Optimized NIDS via Machine Learning in IoT Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Today’s dynamic and hyperactive world is confined to a ball size connectivity only via network and internet. People knowing or unknowingly risk their privacy at a huge rate in the network. Undoubtedly, this is the demand of the time to be digitized and technical. As the population increases, the threat to security increases as well. To detect cyber-attacks and malicious threats to the network, network intrusion detection system is a very prominent concept to deal with them. There is no standard protocol to build up NIDS from scratch as it varies accordingly. Machine learning based NIDS paved a way towards autonomous working of this system keeping in mind that the systems can’t be compared, not even on basic entities or architecture of the system. The paper introduces the recent work and circumstances of the NIDS though the authors didn’t consider the working technique of all the works while implementing. Secondly, a proposed solution for the detection and its methodology has been described in detail while testing it on the UGR ‘16 dataset for further evaluation and benchmarking the durability and efficiency of the model.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Multivariate Imputation by N Neighbour Mean and Chained Equation for Time Series Missing Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Missing or incomplete data introduces numerous challenges during data analysis. If there exists any incomplete data then algorithms used for analysis can produce incorrect results. Data with missing or incomplete values may have a negative effect on computation. Thereby leading to an incorrect result. Certain algorithms are incapable of handling missing data properly, while other methods produce an efficient output to calculate the missing values. Because different machine learning algorithms become less effective when given incomplete data, it is extremely important to manage missing data properly. It could be possible that the data set might contain some missing values for various features due to the following reasons data were maintained in the file, data got corrupted, etc. This paper proposed a method that makes use of N neighbors of the data that is missing and makes use of the machine learning model to tune the computed value so as to impute a correct value for the missing data when the missing data is spread across different features. The proposed model makes use of the spatial characteristics of the time series data in order to predict missing data with the least error. Through experimentation, the proposed model demonstrated a high degree of accuracy in predicting missing values, even when the gaps spanned multiple feature columns.

articleTitle: Sizing of PV and Battery using Greywolf Optimization for Indian Grid-Connected Households
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: In order to calculate the optimum capacity of solar PV and battery energy storage arrangements (BES) for homes that are linked to the grid, the purpose of this article is to find the optimal capacity of these systems. Real-time rule-driven house management systems for energy are used in the process of optimizing the house’s energy usage. The real annual statistics of solar radiation, ambient temperature, home power usage, and electricity price are included in these systems. The method described earlier may be implemented in two different system configurations, namely a home that has both a BES and solar photovoltaic panels. In order to verify that the ideal outcomes have been achieved, the implementation of the uncertainty analysis makes use of actual data spanning 10 years. Along with this, a comprehensive analysis of cash flows is provided in order to emphasize the client payments that were received during every year of the life of the project. Modifying the expense and capacity of system elements, as well as the constraints placed upon the grid, the average daily requirement for power, and the average cost of energy, are all manipulated in order to carry out the sensitivity analysis. The case study that is being addressed here is an ordinary home in India that is linked to the grid. The determination of this work is to provide residential users in India with useful guidance for selecting the ideal PV/BES system for their homes by taking into account their daily average power usage as well as the amount of rooftop space that is available for PV installation. In conclusion, the suggested optimization approach is applied to families in several additional Indian states, and the outcomes of these applications are compared to one another.

articleTitle: ANFIS-based Horse Herd optimization control for a Changing Environment for Energy Management in a Fuel Cell/Ultracapacitor Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The subject of fuel cell/ultra-capacitor hybrid electric vehicle (FCHEV) energy management in the presence of uncertainty is explored in this study. Together with fuel efficiency and the sluggish dynamics of the fuel cell (FC) scheme, durability of the answers is a crucial performance requirement. This study takes into consideration uncertainties affecting electricity supply, conversion, and consumption, while the majority of earlier research has concentrated on getting the best performance within a deterministic framework. Many things, such as changes in operating situations, estimating, and modelling, have been linked to errors. When used in real-world circumstances, ignoring these uncertainties leads to higher operating expenses, a lack of overall scheme competency, poor performance, and even outcomes that are impractical due to limits defilement. When input parameters are uncertain, research is being done on a Horse herd Optimized ANFIS based energy management system (EMS) to ensure ideal yet strong presentation. By including uncertainty into the cost function and constraint set, suggested Horse herd Optimized ANFIS based technique protects the scheme performance from problems with viability and optimality. Due to the conservatism of the Horse herd Optimized ANFIS technique, we introduce conservatism level options to enable for more complex decision-making and reduced performance costs.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Infant Cry Classification Using Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Infant crying noises analysis is essential for understanding and addressing the needs of babies. This research focuses on comparing the performance of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model and a Transformer model for categorizing infant cries into five reasons: hunger, pain, burping needs, discomfort, and tiredness. The models are evaluated on a labeled dataset comprising 457 cry audio files obtained from the Donate a-Cry corpus. Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) are used as features to capture the frequency content of the crying sounds. The Transformer model is developed and compared against the CNN model for classification accuracy. Different augmentation levels are applied to both models for evaluation. The results indicate that the Transformer model exhibits higher accuracy compared to the CNN model across multiple augmentation levels. The highest accuracy is achieved by the Transformer model with 4 augmentations. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the Transformer model for accurately categorizing infant cries based on their underlying reasons. This research contributes to the field of infant cry analysis by highlighting the advantages of utilizing the Transformer model over the traditional CNN model.

articleTitle: Enhancing Steel Melting Shop Operations by Object Detection Using Template Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Ladle monitoring systems are essential for optimizing steel melting operations. They improve material and equipment flow, reduce wait times, increase overall production, enable quick problem response, and ensure steel quality. Traditional ladle tracking methods utilizing sensors require a wide frequency band for data transmission. However, sensor technology has limitations such as high cost, limited range, signal interference, poor integration, wear, and tear. Thus, an additional layer of security is needed. To address these issues, a proposed solution suggests implementing a machine vision system for ladle tracking and management in steel factories. This vision-based system uses a live video captured by a camera as input to detect the ladle. The template matching algorithm is employed to compare the ladle template with the image’s covered window, allowing the system to identify the ladle’s ID and the zone where it is located. Various techniques for template matching are compared, and the most suitable one for the application is selected based on the results. The matched templates are stored in a database using Python SQLite3. The ladle tracking positions can be accessed through a web application, which also provides the capability to track individual ladles. The results demonstrate that implementing a vision-based tracking system for ladles in steel factories offers optimal outcomes with minimal hardware expenses.

articleTitle: Critical Analysis of Blockchain-based Security for The Internet of Things in Enhancing the Future Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The application of “Internet of Things” is a new phenomenon which has supported organisation, individuals and others to transform the manner in which the business operations and other aspects are being connected. The IoT based future technology in an effective manner. The implementation of Blockchain tend to contain more strong protections against any form of data leakage, tampering of the information Hence, it has been stated by many researchers that the application of Blockchain based security support in enhancing the future technology through IoT. This research focuses in understanding the opportunities and address key aspects related to security aspects through IoT in creating better future technology. The researchers tend to use both primary data and secondary data for performing the study, the researchers collate the data from the respondents through survey method, the analysis are then made using AMOS statistical software and meaningful interpretation were presented based on the analysis.

Author Keywords: Correlation analysis and Structural equation model

articleTitle: Use of double channel purification method for purifying water in solar still
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Water purification system helps people to get pure water which will greatly improve their health condition and increases the longevity of their life. Solar still is used to purify the saline water and produce clean water. In rural areas electricity is a great problem and also power cuts are frequent. Traditional method of boiling water for drinking purpose will not solve the problem always. A society can grow better if people are healthy and for better health pure water is required.In this design we are using double channel filtering column to remove larger impurities, smaller impurities and chemical compounds present in the contaminated water as well as solar still to get the desalinated water.Thus this design is solar based double channel water purification system for rural people. Here green energy is used for water purification purpose. Solar energy is directly used in the form of solar thermal and does not cause any environmental pollution. Even no extra electricity is consumed from the grid, neither batteries are required which greatly reduces cost.In this work we have designed the system and test with the sample water from chilika lake which is brackish water. The drinking water made available is free from salts, impurities and different micro-organisms. In this new design twenty litre of water can be purified within a period of 5 hours. Thus this system can be easily installed with a life span of 25 years.

articleTitle: Benefit maximization of prosumer with grid-connected PV-BESS system using Social Group Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Due to benefits like plenty of energy sources, pro-environmental perspective, and simple power extraction, photovoltaic (PV) integrated microgrids have been researched more and more. When a microgrid is linked with distributed energy resources (DERs), such as solar PV systems, there are several difficulties. The necessity for an effective energy management system (EMS) with a suitable pricing structure to benefit both the consumer and the distribution firm arises in order to address these issues. With the use of battery storage systems, the inherent drawbacks of PV, such as its unpredictability in providing electricity, can be lessened. The PV power characteristics are non-linear due to the fluctuating solar irradiation and temperature. In order to produce additional energy, a PV system that can track the maximum power point is required. In order to reduce the overall annual running cost while still functioning within the restrictions of the system, an Energy Management System (EMS) that includes grid-connected batteries with valve-regulated lead-acid energy storage systems and PV module is modelled. Real time load and solar irradiation data are considered. Social group optimization (SGO) is implemented to find out the optimal size of the energy storage system which will provide maximum cost-benefit. Time of use pricing structure is considered where the price changes depending on the load demand. The MATLAB simulation produced good performance results.

articleTitle: Modified Tunicate Swarm Algorithm Based Effective Energy Management For Hybrid Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Recent developments show that renewable energies can sustainably, safely, and expandingly supply all of today’s energy needs. While there are some differences in their findings as a result of climate change, this is a severe problem. In order to overcome this problem, a hybrid source is created and incorporates a variety of diverse energy sources. In order to satisfy demand, increase system’s efficiency, and guarantee the best performance of hybrid systems powered by renewable energy, Energy Management System (EMS) have to be used. This work provides a description of the Modified Tunicate Swarm Algorithm based Modified Incremental Conductance (MTSA-MIC) for a Hybrid Renewable Energy System (HRES). The standard incremental conductance method reacts incorrectly at the initial step shift in the converter duty cycle with an increase in sunlight exposure. The typical algorithm comparison is discussed in this study, and a MIC algorithm that appropriately adjusts to increases in solar irradiation is suggested. Additionally, the suggested algorithm exhibits zero fluctuation in the solar module’s output after tracking the Maximum Power Point (MPP). The recommended MTSA-MIC based EMS evaluates the efficient performance of each HRES sub-system and guarantees network stability with regard to frequency and voltage variations. Comprehensive simulation results show that the proposed MTSAMIC achieves a total harmonic error of 0.78% and a computational time of 1.4 seconds.

articleTitle: IoAT-based Smart Farming Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: The Internet of Things is a game-changing innovation that will change the face of computing and communication forever. The Internet of Agricultural Things (IoAT) is now being used in each sector, from smart houses to smart traffic control to smart cities. The Internet of Things has a wide range of potential applications and can be used in any industry. In this paper, we will discuss how the IoAT can be used in farming. The Internet of Things allows for more efficient farm administration, resource management, economically viable farming, increased yields and harvest yields, Field Surveillance, outdoor observation, etc. The suggested model makes use of a number of Internet of Things sensors, including ones that measure climate conditions, soil acidity, wetness in the soil, moisture in the air, volume of water, and so on. In this research, we examined the conventional farming practices of modern farmers and the issues they confront, and we went to poly homes to learn about cutting-edge farming innovations. The proposed concept is a straightforward architecture of Internet of Things sensors that report data over WiFi to a central server, which then processes the data and takes appropriate action.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Identifying Paddy Leaf Diseases Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) with Machine Learning- A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Paddy leaf diseases substantially threaten global rice production, resulting in significant crop yield losses and economic implications. Therefore, timely detection and accurate identification of these diseases are imperative for effective management strategies. Recent advancements in agricultural technologies have led to Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) emerging as a promising tool for crop monitoring due to their capability to provide higher-resolution and real-time data. This research paper aims to afford a comprehensive outline of the use of UAVs in monitoring and identifying paddy leaf diseases, shedding light on their potential applications, challenges, and prospects. This paper showcases the pivotal role of UAVs in transforming disease monitoring practices in paddy fields. Equipped with sophisticated cameras and sensors, UAVs can capture aerial images and multispectral data of vast agricultural areas efficiently. These data can then be processed and analyzed using state-of-the-art image processing and machine-learning algorithms to identify disease symptoms, classify disease types, and assess the severity of infections. The paper delves into the various UAV-based disease identification techniques, elaborating on image processing methods employed for feature extraction, such as image segmentation, texture analysis, and color space transformations. Finally, the research paper addresses the prospects of UAVs in paddy leaf disease monitoring. The paper also suggests directions for further research on real-time disease mapping and automated spraying systems based on UAV data, aiming to optimize disease management efforts. Applications based on UAVs should dynamically implement pest and nutrient management approaches.

articleTitle: A Transparent and Privacy-Preserving Job Search Platform Built on the Ethereum Blockchain Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: As they can change and alter data governance, blockchain technologies are advancing at a faster rate and are regarded as one of the greatest technologies. These technologies are utilized in a variety of sectors, including the public sector, the supply chain, and e-government. Blockchain offers a reliable and secure method. The technology offers a framework for considerably better re-deployment of the current systems. Several nations have already embraced the use of blockchain in a variety of government operations. This research paper introduces the dApp of a blockchain-based job recruitment platform in light of the significance and influence of blockchain technology. The blockchain-based framework presented in this research study will speed up the current time-consuming hiring procedure.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Smart Locker for Domestic Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: This research work proposes the designing and development of a smart locker system for domestic applications that uses a face identification system to identify authorized and unauthorized persons from opening and stealing valuables. The system is designed to integrate Raspberry Pi, camera, and keypad modules to recognize the authorizer and allow access to the locker. The face identification system uses open CV technology, and the Raspberry Pi is coded using Python programming language to achieve the desired output. The proposed system provides a 4-digit passcode to open the locker, and if the authorizer fails to enter the correct passcode, the locker can only be accessed through the manual key provided by the manufacturer. If an unauthorized person attempts to open the locker, the system shifts to manual lock, and an additional shock protection mechanism is also implemented. The proposed system is expected to offer improved security and convenience for domestic applications. The performance evaluation criteria include testing procedures and protocols, and the experimental results are presented and analyzed. The research work concludes with suggestions for future research work in the field of smart lockers and face identification systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technique Based Tomato Plant Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Industrial Electronics: Developments & Applications (ICIDeA)
abstract: Agriculture is crucial for society, by providing food, raw materials, and livelihoods. Timely detection and management of plant diseases are vital to minimize crop losses and maximize productivity. However, manual disease detection is time-consuming and subjective. This calls for automated solutions to plant health detection. Deep learning models have proved to give a promising solution to real-time image-based disease detection. There exist numerous research works that utilize these deep learning techniques to classify plant diseases. An efficient deep learning-based model is very important for the leaf disease classification problem. The work focusses on detecting and identification of disease in the leaf of tomato plant, one of the vegetables cultivated in the Ettimadai Village, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. The work employs convolutional neural network and VGG-16 that are trained, tested, and validated using available image samples. The models are fed with data available in Kaggle and tomato leaf images captured from J. P. Nursery, Mettankadu, Madukkarai, Tamil Nadu, India. The models are analysed for its performance and the best model is selected for real time prediction of diseases. The proposed work enhances disease identification, enables early detection, and potentially minimizes crop losses, thereby improving yields and income. The leveraging performance of artificial intelligence-based systems for plant disease detection contribute to food security, economic development, and sustainable farming practices.
